products.name: Oracle C2M Batch Scheduling & Thread-Pool Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure and manage C2M batch — threadpool workers, scheduling and dependencies, scheduler integration, and monitoring — so jobs run on time and complete, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run C2M batch reliably — threadpools, schedules, and monitoring

C2M does its heavy lifting in batch — billing, meter reads, and more — and batch that's mis-scheduled or under-resourced quietly breaks the business. This solution configures and manages C2M batch: threadpool workers, batch scheduling and dependencies, DBMS scheduler/enterprise scheduler integration, and batch monitoring — so jobs run on time and complete, pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M batch architecture: threadpool workers, batch control, scheduling, dependencies, and monitoring.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (C2M environment, threadpool config, scheduler, DB access).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure named threadpool workers, set up batch scheduling and dependencies, integrate the scheduler, and validate throughput and completion, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (threadpools up, jobs complete, no backlog) plus Best Practices for batch sizing and scheduling.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M batch that runs on time and completes — threadpools sized, schedules and dependencies correct, backlog visible — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MBATCH-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of C2M batch controls, thread pools, and recent run history
    • OC2MBATCH-Remediation.sh — align worker thread-pool config to the standard set (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MBATCH-Report.sql — read-only batch run-status, throughput, and backlog report from the C2M schema
    • OC2MBATCH-ScopeHelper.sh — build the in-scope batch-control and worker-node target list for pilot and expansion
    • OC2MBATCH-Validation.sh — read-only validation that workers advertise the standard pools and the scheduler/JMX are reachable

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
